Trend Micro is one of the clearest pure plays in this screener, since its business already revolves around AI driven threat detection, incident response and security software that can sit between powerful models and the open internet.

Trend Micro develops cybersecurity platforms across cloud, endpoint, network and consumer protection, with AI infused tools like Vision One, XDR and incident response services.
